name: pyjoyment-bundled
description: The JavaScript libraries of the bundled templates of Pyjoyment, which npm run bundle copies into Pyjoyment/resources/public/pyjo, zod, whose schemas the tests compare with the ones of Pyjo.JSON.Schema, JSON-Schema-Test-Suite, which the tests run on its validation, and Biome, which formats and lints CSS, HTML, JavaScript, JSON, Markdown and YAML

scripts.bundle: node --input-type=module --eval "import fs from 'node:fs'; const { bundle } = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('package.json')).pyjoyment; for (const [to, from] of Object.entries(bundle)) fs.copyFileSync('node_modules/' + from, to);"
